page.overview:
Who is Achilles Milo?

A renowned chemist who turned to crime, Doctor Achilles Milo used a variety of chemical and medical-related schemes to kill Batman.

Milo eventually reappeared after his survival from the werewolf attack and he took control of Arkham Asylum in order to use some of the inmates for his crimes.

During this scheme, Milo attempted to make Batman insane with yet another gas, but his plan backfired and he was exposed to the chemicals that drove him insane, forcing him to become an inmate of Arkham Asylum.

Batman consulted him on at least one occasion when he needed chemical expertise given to him by Joker. After that, Doctor Milo seemingly retired from criminal activity. During 52, Milo was an inmate at the Haven Correctional Facility. He had lost his legs under undisclosed circumstances and used a wheelchair containing a mystical wheel, which was later stolen by Ralph Dibny as part of a trap to capture Felix Faust.
